#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Unified error handler for request validation failures
error() {
  echo "Error: Malformed request" >&2
  exit 1
}

# Ensure WARRANTY_WORKSPACE is set
if [[ -z "${WARRANTY_WORKSPACE:-}" ]]; then
  echo "Error: WARRANTY_WORKSPACE not set." >&2
  exit 1
fi

DATA_FILE="${WARRANTY_WORKSPACE}/warranty-workspace.json"

# Ensure data file exists
if [[ ! -f "$DATA_FILE" ]]; then
  echo "Error: Data file $DATA_FILE not found." >&2
  exit 1
fi

case "$1" in
  allocate)
    shift
    REQUEST_JSON="$1"

    # Validate JSON array
    if ! jq -e 'type == "array"' <<< "$REQUEST_JSON" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      error
    fi

    NUM_GROUPS=$(jq 'length' <<< "$REQUEST_JSON")
    NUM_BRANDS=$(jq 'length' "$DATA_FILE")

    # Group count must match brand count
    if [[ "$NUM_GROUPS" -ne "$NUM_BRANDS" ]]; then
      error
    fi

    # All elements must be positive integers
    if ! jq -e 'map(type=="number" and . > 0 and (. == floor(.))) | all' <<< "$REQUEST_JSON" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      error
    fi

    # Check seat availability
    if ! jq --argjson req "$REQUEST_JSON" -e '
      def idx(k): (keys_unsorted | index(k));
      to_entries
      | map(.value >= ($req[ idx(.key) ]))
      | all
    ' "$DATA_FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      error
    fi

    # All checks passed – update seat counts
    NEW_JSON=$(jq --argjson req "$REQUEST_JSON" '
      def idx(k): (keys_unsorted | index(k));
      to_entries
      | map({key: .key, value: .value - ($req[ idx(.key) ])})
      | from_entries
    ' "$DATA_FILE")
    echo "$NEW_JSON" > "$DATA_FILE"
    ;;
  free)
    shift
    REQUEST_JSON="$1"

    if ! jq -e 'type == "array"' <<< "$REQUEST_JSON" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      error
    fi

    NUM_GROUPS=$(jq 'length' <<< "$REQUEST_JSON")
    NUM_BRANDS=$(jq 'length' "$DATA_FILE")

    if [[ "$NUM_GROUPS" -ne "$NUM_BRANDS" ]]; then
      error
    fi

    if ! jq -e 'map(type=="number" and . > 0 and (. == floor(.))) | all' <<< "$REQUEST_JSON" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      error
    fi

    NEW_JSON=$(jq --argjson req "$REQUEST_JSON" '
      def idx(k): (keys_unsorted | index(k));
      to_entries
      | map({key: .key, value: .value + ($req[ idx(.key) ])})
      | from_entries
    ' "$DATA_FILE")
    echo "$NEW_JSON" > "$DATA_FILE"
    ;;
  balance)
    jq '.' "$DATA_FILE"
    ;;
  list)
    jq 'to_entries | map(.key)' "$DATA_FILE"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "Usage: $0 {allocate|free|balance|list} [args]" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac
